name: Starlify
description_en:
Starlify is a product in the Team collaboration category. Its directory profile covers Synchronous Editing, Cooperative Writing, Task Management, Project Management, Document Management.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large). API support is listed as NA. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available Offers Free-forever and Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: create, assign and track units of work; coordinate project tasks, responsibilities and progress; organize documents and control their access and revisions. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务）。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织。API 支持情况为未注明。资料所列支持方式为在线支持。
